title: The Pronamic Pay WordPress plugin before 11.1.0, Pronamic Pay doneren met Mollie WordPress plugin before 1.7.1 do not…
description: The Pronamic Pay WordPress plugin versions before 11.1.0 and the Pronamic Pay doneren met Mollie WordPress plugin versions before 1.7.1 do not restrict access to stored form submissions via the REST API. This allows unauthenticated users to read messages submitted by visitors through the bundled forms.
